note: MEDIA lane. Illustrative industry imagery added by the redesign (BUILD-CONTRACT 4.5). Every file is AI-generated and labelled (IPTC trainedAlgorithmicMedia); none depicts Star Buds, its stores, staff, customers, products or brands. src/build.mjs reads images[] { id, file, cutout?, alt } and the loop slots { id, kind: 'video', alt, video }; tools/fal-gen.mjs reads defaults + prompt/input.

defaults.style: cinematic night photograph, deep emerald and bottle-green shadows, warm amber lantern light, small touches of aged brass, faint drifting mist, natural rich colour, fine film grain, sharp focus, no people, no hands, no faces, no text, no lettering, no labels, no logos, no signage, all surfaces blank and unmarked
